title: Sunday Ko Space Station Ke Liye Cargo Launch
topic: Event: Northrop Grumman CRS-25 Cygnus XL cargo launch on a Falcon 9 targeted Sunday Nov 29, 2026 ~10:47 a.m. EST from Cape Canaveral; ~11,000 lb cargo incl. science experiments; ISS capture by Canadarm2 Dec 1; stays until May 2027.
hook: Astronauts ke liye Sunday ko cargo launch hoga!
cliffhanger_question: Live launch dekhna chahoge? Haan ya naa?
summary: Event reel: Cygnus XL cargo ship launches on Falcon 9 on Nov 29, 2026 (target, may slip), carrying about 11,000 lb (~5,000 kg) of supplies and experiments; Canadarm2 captures it Dec 1; stays at the ISS until May 2027.
